title: Alley Ross takes the band into Blackbirds of 1928
summary: The band moves to Lew Leslie's Blackbirds edition downtown.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did Alley Ross one time conduct the Henderson band?
You see how liberal they were, good sports. I thought gangsters was just gangsters. All they'd do is shoot you and rob you. I had never come in contact with them.

Yeah. But they were just the opposite. So -- well, see, bands have commitments. (Unintelligible) the services aren't needed. We played our commitment there. Then Alley got the call for another edition of Blue Leslie's Blackbirds, downtown.

Well, we had the men that could play it. And they were all experienced showmen, had experience playing shows. Alley took the same band down there, and we played that whole time, for the show. We played the whole edition there, Leslie's Blackbirds. The last one they had, that was in 1928.
